title: SB_Pipeline: 16S amplicon and qPCR analysis pipeline for stingless bee gut microbiomes
description:
Analysis code for Gain and loss of gut symbionts during stingless bee diversification is linked to host group size. The pipeline processes 16S rRNA V4 amplicon data from stingless bee (Apidae: Meliponini) guts across two independent datasets: a global collection of 190 samples spanning 50 species from 15 countries, and a Costa Rica collection of 191 samples from 5 species across 9 colonies.

It covers contaminant identification with decontam, alpha and beta diversity, qPCR-based absolute abundance estimation, and phylogenetic comparative methods (PGLS, Pagel's lambda, ancestral state reconstruction) testing symbiont presence and abundance against host colony size.

Input data are archived at Dryad (doi:10.5061/dryad.0k6djhbhk) and raw sequence reads at the European Nucleotide Archive (PRJEB97714).
